text:
Noelle Kim: Hey everyone  first week check-in. My monitor shipment arrived but the power brick was missing from the box. Also when I connected the spare USB-C cable the external keyboard shows as "Unknown Device" and Wi-Fi briefly drops. Who handles missing parts and quick desk swaps?

Sam Bennett: Welcome Noelle! Ugh packaging goof. Pinged ops. Quick Q: what's the monitor model and dock model listed on the packing slip/sticker?

Noelle Kim: Monitor is Viewline 27Q, dock is listed as HyperDock S4. Box had HDMI and cables but no power brick. Desk is D4-08.

Ravi Patel: @Noelle Kim thanks. Can you try disconnecting HyperDock, reboot the laptop, then plug the monitor directly (HDMI->Mac) and test keyboard directly into laptop USB? Helps isolate dock vs monitor.

Noelle Kim: Plugged monitor direct  screen works. Keyboard when direct works. So looks dock-related and missing brick.

Dana Ortiz: Creating ticket and checking ops kit. it-bot: please create a ticket.

it-bot: New ticket created: IT-5238 - "HyperDock S4 missing power brick + USB devices not enumerating". Assigned to Dana Ortiz. ETA: same-day ops drop if available.

Dana Ortiz: Ops has one spare power brick for HyperDock and a loaner HyperDock S2 we can drop for testing. I can swing by with both around 2pm. Noelle, are you at desk D4-08 now?

Noelle Kim: Yes I'm at D4-08. 2pm works. Thanks!

Ravi Patel: If the loaner S2 resolves the USB/Wi-Fi, we'll RMA the S4. Also note: HyperDock S4 had a firmware update last quarter that fixed sleep-handshake issues  if we RMA, ops will note firmware on the replacement.

Sam Bennett: Heads up Noelle  some new hires had S4 that needed the power brick because the dock uses active power to supply the hub controller; without the brick the hub can partially enumerate which leads to weird dropouts.

Dana Ortiz: Dropped by at 14:05 with power brick (BR-44) and loaner HyperDock S2 (asset HD-9002). Plugged brick into S4 and rebooted Mac. S4 still didn't enumerate USB devices. Swapped in S2 and devices show up immediately. Left a sticky with asset tag.

Noelle Kim: Confirmed  S2 works, keyboard and mouse stable, Wi-Fi didn't drop after sleep test. Thanks Dana!

Ravi Patel: Marking IT-5238 as resolved: replaced faulty HyperDock S4 with loaner HD-9002 (RMA logged for S4). Ops to ship missing power brick back to vendor with the RMA. Noelle  if you want the S2 permanently, ops can swap asset record; otherwise we'll bring a refreshed S4 with firmware applied.

it-bot: Ticket IT-5238 status changed to RESOLVED by Dana Ortiz on 1779502675.
